Here is a draft for your LinkedIn post:

I’m thrilled to announce that I’ve officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)! 🎉

I have been working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, and it has been incredible to watch it evolve and transform healthcare interoperability over the years. Stepping into this new role, I am deeply excited to help move the standard forward and shape the future of clinical decision support. 

A quick note for the community: 
✅ **If you are already using the standard:** We want to know! Please help us map the ecosystem by adding your implementation to our availability wiki here: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

🚀 **If you aren’t using it yet:** Let’s talk. I am currently available as a freelance consultant and would love to help your organization navigate and accelerate your CDS Hooks implementation. Feel free to send me a DM!

Looking forward to this next chapter! 

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareTech #HealthInformatics #Consulting
